name: Scale for Hospital Operations
desc: Five hospital workflow apps for referrals, records and safety events on-premises.
desc_zh: 面向转诊、病历和安全事件的五个医院工作流应用，可部署在自有环境里。
solves: Referrals, chart summaries and safety reviews pile up faster than staff can clear them, and generic AI is not built for decisions where a mistake lands on a patient.
solves_zh: 转诊、病历摘要和安全审查堆积的速度超过医护能清完的速度，而通用 AI 并不是为「错一次就落到病人身上」的决策设计的。
best_for: A hospital's referral queue and safety-event reviews are weeks behind and you need the data to stay inside the health system.
best_for_zh: 医院的转诊队列和安全事件审查已经落后几周，而数据又必须留在医疗系统内部时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://scale.com/blog/sitemap.xml and https://scale.com/enterprise/healthca）。 Announced 2026-11-16, inside the window; not in the ledger (the ledger holds only Scale AI@2016-06-01). The post says the applications run on any model and deploy directly into the customer's environment, with more rolling out over the coming months. No dedicated product page exists; the homepage is the healthcare industry page. Second source is the same publisher. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：它是一组可部署到客户环境里的工作流应用，不是 API 服务；原分类 enterprise-api 不对。 首次公开日期来源：https://scale.com/blog/scaleforhospitaloperations
